card.title: Private Access
card.instruction: Use shared confidences and private knowledge as quiet leverage, never stating how much influence that closeness gives you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your toast at my wedding dinner, I've still got the key to our old keepsake box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please don't tell my parents about the resignation letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'd appreciate the same care with the story about my first marriage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the opening. What am I supposed to say?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with how well we keep each other's confidence. Your parents will like that.
